title: SOS trust gate: RevokedPeerError silent-drop path untested
description: From kimi-k3 security review of worker6-tx4w (fixed). python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py:268-272 catches TrustError broadly; the RevokedPeerError subclass path (store.revoke(iid) then a validly-signed POST from the revoked key) is reachable via public API but has no test. KeyMismatchError and TOFU-pin paths were covered under tx4w. Add: pin key via valid POST, store.revoke(iid), fresh SosResource with same store, valid seq-advancing POST -> assert silent drop + not active.
close_reason: Added regression coverage for revoked SOS peers: valid advancing signed POST is silently dropped and does not activate a fresh resource.
